newsitem.title: ALBANIA: SOCCER-PORTUGAL TOO STRONG FOR ALBANIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGAL TOO STRONG FOR ALBANIA.

text.p: Two goals in the last 13 minutes secured Portugal a welcome 3-0 victory over Albania on Wednesday, their first victory in three matches in World Cup qualifying group nine.
With only one point from their first two games in Armenia and Ukraine, Portugal desperately needed a good result in the reconstructed Qemal Stafa stadium.

But despite an 11th minute goal from Luis Figo, who surprised Albanian goalkeeper Fotaq Strakosha from 25 metres to score his second of the qualifying campaign, they took a long time to gain further reward for their superior technique.
Helder finally made the game safe after a counter-attack down the Albanian right, but not before goalkeeper Vitor Baia had been forced into action on several occasions.
Rui Costa added a third goal in the 89th minute.

Albania - Fotaq Strakosha, Gjergji Dema (Sokol Kushta, 46th), Eduard Abazi (Saimir Malko, 83rd), Arjan Xhumba, Rudi Vata, Artur Lekbello, Kliton Bozgo, Bledar Kola, Salvador Kacaj, Altin Rraklli, Lefter Millo (Viktor Paco, 78th)

Portugal - Vitor Baia, Carlos Secretario, Paulinho Santos, Oceano Cruz (Jose Taira Pereira, 85th), Fernando Couto, Helder Cristovao, Luis Figo (Nuno Rocha Capucho, 88th), Joao Pinto, Ricardo Sa Pinto, Rui Costa, Antonio Folha (Paulo Bento, 63rd).
